messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a sticky-cohort softflip for feature flag `model-routing-v2` in 15m. Goal: validate session affinity and KV cache behavior before full rollout.
jon: +1. Can you paste the ramp plan?
priya: suggest starting at 5% sticky cohorts, not 10. Keep ability to drain fast.
maria: Plan: 5% -> 20% after 30m -> 50% after 2h if signal clean. Sticky cohorts so sessions stay on v2 for 24h. Rollback criteria: 5% increase in 5xx rate or +15% latency p95 on inference path.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: release/softflip-2026-03 (id: d-8821). Estimated start: in 12m.
jon: Who's on-call for infra metrics? @nate?
nate: I’m watching. I’ll post dashboards and set an alert for p95 > 200ms and error rate > 0.5%.
lena: Remember to pin model package v2.1.3 on the dedicated pool so we don't route to a newer snapshot. Otherwise will get mixed runtimes.
priya: Good call. Maria — please include version pin in the rollout command.
maria: Will do. Command I'm about to run: ```rctl rollout feature-toggle set model-routing-v2 --sticky --cohort-percent 5 --pin-version v2.1.3 --note "softflip sticky cohorts"```
priya: Also add a soft disable window in case we need immediate drain: `rctl rollout feature-toggle disable model-routing-v2 --drain-seconds 60`
maria: Deploy job started. @deploy-bot please post events.
deploy-bot: Job started: d-8821 — toggling `model-routing-v2` to 5% sticky cohorts. Tracing id: trace-0a9f.
nate: Dashboards in #eng-oncall: https://dash.company/p/model-route — watching latency, 5xx, and KV cache hit rate. Alerting configured.
jon: Quick QA checklist: confirm tokenization pipeline unchanged, session affinity cookie present, and KV cache warms within 5 minutes.
lena: Confirmed model pool pinned -> v2.1.3, autoscaler rules unchanged.
priya: Noted: release notes link -> https://docs.company/releases/softflip-2026-03 (includes rollback playbook).
maria: 5% live now. Please react with :eyes: when you see stable metrics.
nate: :eyes: p95 = 118ms, 5xx delta = 0.0%, KV hitrate steady at 93% (5m).
jon: Seeing a small uptick in tokenization latency but within tolerance. :thumbsup:
priya: Holding next jump to 20% until we hit 30m stable window. If any alert fires, we back out to 0% and pin back to v2.1.2.
maria: Agreed. I'll schedule the next step at +30m. Logging rollout steps to the release notes doc.
sre-bot: Alert rule deployed: p95_latency_model_route > 200ms for 3m -> page oncall.
priya: Also add a quick smoke check for embeddings consistency after 30m (sample set).
maria: Copy. Will run smoke check at +25m.
deploy-bot: Event: rollout step completed -> 5% sticky cohorts enabled (d-8821).
nate: No alerts so far. KV cache warm time ~2m.
jon: If all remains green at 30m, proceed to 20% and keep sticky for another verification period. If anything looks off, we execute immediate drain and rollback.
lena: Ops note: when draining, use `--graceful` option to preserve in-flight sessions for 60s.
maria: Thanks team. Keeping this thread for updates. If we need to abort, I'll post `ABORT` and trigger the disable command.
priya: Thanks — standby.
(30m later) maria: Proceeding to 20% now. Running: ```rctl rollout feature-toggle set model-routing-v2 --sticky --cohort-percent 20```
deploy-bot: Event: rollout step completed -> 20% sticky cohorts enabled.
nate: p95 = 130ms, 5xx delta = +0.2% (within threshold). Embedding sample diff < 0.1% mismatch.
jon: good to continue.
maria: On track for 50% after 2h if signals remain within thresholds. Leaving this thread open for the next checks.
